Introduce coordinates from the image: let the top rectangle have dimensions q by a, the right rectangle have dimensions (8−q) by b, the bottom-left rectangle have dimensions p by (8−a), the shaded rectangle have dimensions (q−p) by (b−a), and the bottom-right rectangle have dimensions (8−p) by (8−b). Match these five unordered dimension pairs to {1×6, 2×4, 5×6, 2×7, 2×3}. The consistent assignment is top = 6×5, right = 2×7, bottom-left = 2×3, bottom-right = 6×1, and shaded = 4×2. Since 4×2 is rectangle B, the shaded rectangle is B.
